classification.description: SEEK's top-level job family. Leave empty for all families.
classification.title: Classification

companyName.description: Only jobs from this employer or recruiter, e.g. "Dental Boutique".
companyName.title: Company name

country.description: Australia (seek.com.au) or New Zealand (seek.co.nz). NZ keyword searches use SEEK's New Zealand market automatically.
country.title: Market

dateRange.description: Only jobs posted within this window. SEEK's own date filter, re-checked per record.
dateRange.title: Date posted

excludeKeywords.description: Local filter: drop jobs whose text contains any of these phrases.
excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords

includeKeywords.description: Local filter: keep jobs whose title, company, teaser, bullets, description, classification, work type or salary contains at least one phrase.
includeKeywords.title: Include keywords

includeOneInTitle.description: Local filter: keep jobs whose title contains at least one of these phrases (case-insensitive).
includeOneInTitle.sectionDescription: These run after records are collected. Contact filters switch on job-detail fetching automatically.
includeOneInTitle.title: Title must include one of

location.description: City, suburb or region, e.g. "Sydney", "Geelong", "Auckland". Use with the state and radius below to narrow a keyword search.
location.title: Location

maxConcurrency.description: How many job-detail requests run at once. Higher is faster; lower is gentler on SEEK.
maxConcurrency.title: Parallel detail requests

maxItems.description: Total rows across all search terms and URLs. SEEK caps each individual query at 550 results; add more search terms to collect beyond that.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Each row is one job. Fields SEEK does not provide are omitted rather than sent as empty values.
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs

postCode.description: Australian 4-digit postcode. Used as the search location when no city is supplied.
postCode.title: Postcode

radius.description: Radius around the location or postcode. Requires Location or Postcode to have an effect.
radius.title: Radius (km)

requireEmail.description: Keep only jobs with an email in SEEK's structured contact data or the description. Turns on detail fetching.
requireEmail.title: Require an email address

requireEmailPhone.description: Keep only jobs that expose both an email address and a phone number. Turns on detail fetching.
requireEmailPhone.title: Require both email and phone

requirePhone.description: Keep only jobs with a phone number in SEEK's structured contact data or the description. Turns on detail fetching.
requirePhone.title: Require a phone number

salaryMax.description: Maximum salary in the market's currency. SEEK's salary filter plus a local check on the parsed salary label.
salaryMax.title: Salary maximum

salaryMin.description: Minimum salary in the market's currency. SEEK's salary filter plus a local check on the parsed salary label. Jobs with no disclosed salary are kept unless a Salary basis is selected.
salaryMin.title: Salary minimum

salaryType.description: Annual or hourly. Old values (AnnualPackage, YearlyPackage, HourlyRate, MonthlyPackage) are mapped automatically. When set, jobs without a parsed salary of that basis are skipped.
salaryType.title: Salary basis

scrapeJobDetails.description: Fetch each job's full description, contact data, company profile, applicant count and expiry via SEEK's detail API. Off = listing-card fields only (title, company, salary label, location, work type).
scrapeJobDetails.title: Fetch full job details

searchTerms.description: One search per keyword phrase, e.g. "python developer", "registered nurse". Results from all phrases are merged and de-duplicated.
searchTerms.title: Search terms

searchUrls.description: Paste SEEK search URLs, category pages, company pages or direct job links. AU and NZ links can be mixed. Leave empty to search by keywords/filters below.
searchUrls.sectionDescription: Search by URL, by keyword, or browse with the filters below. A keyword search runs when searchTerms is filled; a URL search runs for every URL listed here.
searchUrls.title: Search or job URLs

state.description: Australian state or territory. State abbreviations from old tasks are mapped automatically. For VIC and WA, SEEK resolves a state-only search to Melbourne/Perth; add a regional city under Location for regional jobs.
state.title: State / territory

subclassifications.description: One or more SEEK subclassification IDs or exact names, e.g. "6290" or "Engineering - Software". Each selection runs its own SEEK search so multiple values are all covered.
subclassifications.title: Subclassifications

workArrangements.description: Keep only on-site, hybrid or remote jobs.
workArrangements.title: Work arrangements

workTypes.description: Keep only these employment types. Applied on SEEK's side, so pages fill with matching jobs.
workTypes.sectionDescription: All filters are applied on SEEK's side where the search API supports them, and re-checked on every record so results stay honest.
workTypes.title: Work types
